title: Awesome Aromatic British Pecan Nuts Onigiri
description: A fermented and silky British dish featuring pecan nuts, shaped like nigiri, and suitable for halal diets as a hangover cure.
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and cook the rice according to the package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, then let it cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, cooled vinegar mixture, and chopped pecan nuts, and mix well.
Add the miso paste to the rice mixture and mix until the paste is fully incorporated.
Cut the dried seaweed sheets into small squares, about 2 inches per side.
Using wet hands, shape the rice mixture into small triangular or oval shapes, and wrap each shape with a seaweed sheet.
Serve the onigiri immediately, or store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a day.
